description: This file defines a sealed class 'ExpressionItemTemplateSelector' that inherits from 'DataTemplateSelector'. It overrides the 'SelectTemplateCore' method to select different data templates based on the type of expression token (operator, operand, separator). It also exposes properties for each template type.

classes.name: ExpressionItemTemplateSelector
classes.description: A data template selector that chooses templates based on the type of expression token.

methods.name: SelectTemplateCore
methods.description: Overrides the base method to select a data template based on the token type.
